technical.summary: Short-term momentum is overbought with bullish micro-signals, but price remains below key moving averages and long-term trend is bearish; high risk of pullback in weak macro structure.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 90 days—insufficient smart money alignment to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and lightweight with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (299.68) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 90 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for multinational MMM.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme market fear (31/100) creates contrarian opportunity, short-term RSI/Stoch overbought with Ichimoku TK bullish cross suggests micro-momentum reversal potential, and DXY tailwind supports multinational exporters.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA/SMA 20/50/200) with bearish crossovers, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX crisis levels (299.68), and earnings event risk in 90 days create severe macro headwinds that overwhelm short-term overbought signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme market fear creates contrarian setup, and short-term overbought RSI/Stoch with Ichimoku TK cross suggest micro-momentum reversal. However, macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession signals) and price trapped below all major moving averages make this a low-conviction trade unsuitable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels (299.68) signal severe macro stress; earnings event in 90 days adds volatility risk that could trigger sharp reversal below support.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows short-term bullish signals but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly favor bear case; sentiment alone supports contrarian buy but is outweighed by macro severity.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM position with 8 other Industrials positions (27% sector concentration); adding to existing position increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment.
